slot_scores.name: max_shifts_per_week
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any additional requirements not mentioned in the brief, such as limits on the number of days a student can work per week, restrictions on consecutive days off, or rules about which students are eligible for which time slots?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about a limit on the number of days/shifts a student can work per week, and then clarified the meaning in turn 11, directly targeting the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: max_students_per_day
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a daily cap on the number of distinct students assigned to duty. The catch-all in turn 10 listed a days-per-week limit but not a distinct-students-per-day limit; the fact was only surfaced because the user simulator volunteered it, and turn 12 merely clarified volunteered info.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_gross_pay
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total weekly labor cost (sum of wage × hours for all students), or is there a different objective such as maximizing fairness or minimizing total hours worked?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and named minimizing total labor cost, matching the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: By the slot-hit standard, H2 (max distinct students per day) was never proactively asked about and remains unresolved as a P1 slot when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL; although the user volunteered it, the agent earned no hit for it. H1 and H3 (P0) were resolved.

summary: The agent recovered the objective (H3) and the weekly days-per-student limit (H1) through direct questions, but never proactively probed the daily distinct-student cap (H2), which only appeared because the user volunteered it. It also repeated the integrality question several times and stopped at READY_TO_MODEL with H2 unresolved by its own questioning.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
